title: Unwrap
hints: If the build complains that the second argument to errors.As must implement error: QueryError doesn't have an Error method yet. errors.Is and errors.As follow a chain by calling an Unwrap() error method on each error. A custom error that wraps a cause should provide one.
Error() can include the cause's message: fmt.Sprintf("query %q: %v", e.Query, e.Err). Unwrap just returns e.Err. In Run, wrap the failure from exec in a *QueryError.
func (e *QueryError) Unwrap() error { return e.Err }; Run: if err := exec(q); err != nil { return &QueryError{Query: q, Err: err} }; return nil
